sources.name: DMart Investor Relations - Investor Updates (FY2026-27)
sources.notes: Loads in a browser (JavaScript-rendered; a plain HTTP fetch returned only the page shell). Lists all exchange filings - results, press releases, store-opening intimations, management changes - with PDFs served from api.dmartindia.com. No RSS. The path is per fiscal year (e.g. /2025-2026), so update it each April.

sources.name: NSE - Latest corporate announcements (RSS)
sources.notes: Valid RSS ('NSE News - Latest Announcements'); 59 items at check, newest 18-Oct-2026 20:38. Market-wide: filter by item title (company name, e.g. 'Avenue Supermarts Limited') or by the attachment filename prefix (e.g. 'DMART_', 'MEDPLUS_', 'VMM_'). Loaded in a browser; a server-side fetch timed out, so polling may need browser-like headers. Review NSE website terms before automated polling.

sources.name: BSE - Avenue Supermarts corporate announcements
sources.notes: Loads in a browser (JavaScript-rendered, filterable list); plain HTTP fetch returned HTTP 403. No RSS verified. Use the NSE feed or DMart IR for automation.

sources.name: MR D.I.Y. Investor Relations - Newsroom (Bursa announcements mirror)
sources.notes: Works with plain HTTP fetch. Mirrors Bursa announcements with reference numbers and attachments (15 per page; newest 15 Oct 2026 at check). Filters: /cat/11588 (financial results), /year/2026. No RSS - e-mail alerts only.

sources.name: MR D.I.Y. Investor Relations - Press releases

sources.name: Bursa Malaysia - Company announcements (MR D.I.Y., stock code 5296)
sources.notes: Loads in a browser (JavaScript-rendered table; newest row 16 Oct 2026 at check); plain HTTP fetch returned HTTP 403. Change company= to 5326 for 99 Speed Mart (that variant was not separately tested). Bursa market data is licensed - check terms before automated use.

sources.name: 99 Speed Mart - Financial Information (IR)

sources.notes: Loads, but contains only codes/policies, board committees and the investor-grievance contact - no announcements or financials. Unlisted company; rely on press feeds and CRISIL rating rationales for updates.
